classification: pre-registered walk-forward test of platform-centre selection versus chasing the trailing best cell; research-only

decision.secondary_maximin_note: P4 is one of five correlated policies and does not beat the fixed centre on mean forward return; its better worst case is reported but not promoted as a new selection rule.

known_limits: All 27 cells and both the 7-cell hold-30 region and the fixed centre were already observed in R371/R373/R374; this is a post-hoc policy test, not a new independent alpha discovery.
The curves are composed from B-sleeve curves generated on the 2022-05-05 start, so the earliest decision point is about 2023-05 and the test covers roughly 30 monthly decisions.
Overlapping 252-session forward windows are strongly autocorrelated; effective sample size is far below the nominal count.
Current HS300 membership and current industry snapshot backfill remain non-point-in-time inputs.
Only 2x cost is evaluated here; R374 already covers the 3x and 5x diagnostics for the hold-30 region.
